essence: Devotional satisfaction of the dancer leads her to perform an effective service for the practitioner.
The dancer continually supplies the practitioner with wealth and materials for spiritual accomplishment.
The practitioner gains comprehensive knowledge of past and future events.
Every desire of the practitioner is fulfilled without exception.
Proper meditation requires prior ritual installation and a serene mental state.
